## How to Delete Images & Files from the Media Manager


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047891

To delete an image or file that is not being used by the website, follow these steps: Open My Content > Media Manager .

Locate the image or file to delete, hover the mouse over it, and click the trash can icon ( Erase ).

Click OK to confirm.

Once deleted, the image or file is removed from the site and no longer uses storage or bandwidth.

IMPORTANT: Delete only images and files that are not actively referenced. An image still in use by areas such as Brand Images , Homepage Settings , Banner Ads , or Web Pages will appear as broken once removed, because the file path in the code no longer resolves.
